description: The controller layouts the options screen offers and resets to: under "usa" the three types A, B and C, in that order. Each layout maps a game action (enter, cancel, skip, action, aim, light, run, view, step_left, step_right, pause, item, map, option) to the PS1 pad buttons that trigger it: Select, Start, Triangle, Circle, Cross, Square, L1, L2, R1, R2. PC keyboard and mouse bindings are separate (config.cfg and the controls screen). A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.
